semantic_rules: All commands require live local session/Host/Origin/CSRF, If-Match on existing mutable aggregate and Idempotency-Key.
Create template binds caller-provided template_id only if absent with If-None-Match:*; revision/content hashes derived server side.
Canonical Job remains unchanged; LibraryTask.id maps same persistent job id; batch payload is internal typed LibraryIntent. No shot_batch reuse.
Apply validates exact plan revision/hash, ordered selected closure/hash, root epochs and unexpired one-use confirmation; idempotent same payload returns original op without second token consumption.
Native root registration uses trusted local IPC/CLI, not HTTP arbitrary-path endpoint.
GET /rename-plans/{id} is summary-only (no inline items); /items is bounded keyset pagination. Full exact-plan JSON/CSV exports stream all frozen rows including conflicts.

Description/template current-head GET/create/revision success MUST return strong ETag header bound to returned revision; If-Match uses exact header, missing428/stale412/no-side-effect; If-None-Match:* creates only absent template.

Conflict preview rows are retained with duplicate target keys; apply validates selected dependency closure and unique selected targets, then reserves targets atomically in file_target_reservation before disk intent. Duplicate selected targets409 with zero file actions; no dropping rows.
Forward/undo retry plans use /file-operations/{id}/retry-plans with current operation If-Match and last_event_seq; no blind legacy Job retry. Details in job-compatibility.json and docs34.
Library task accounting_ref resolves bounded /accounting and /accounting/items views; actual attempts/observed calls separated, unmeasured time/calls null, not manufactured zero.
